title: RTEC ADA complaint process authority map

process_source.source_path: TITLE VI LEP PLAN/ADA/ADA COMPLAINT PROCESS.doc

complaint_form_source.source_path: TITLE VI LEP PLAN/ADA/RTEC ADA Complaint Form 2.xls

scope: Complaints alleging disability discrimination in RTEC services, vehicles or facilities.
historical_deadlines: Complaint filed within 5 calendar days of alleged incident.
ADA Coordinator contacts complainant within 10 business days of receipt.
Requested information due to RTEC within 5 days.
Investigation begins within 15 business days of receipt when the allegation is found to present an ADA-regulation issue.
Investigation completed within 60 calendar days of complaint receipt unless additional time is needed and the complainant is notified.
Appeal due within 5 business days after receipt of RTEC's response.
accessibility_and_intake: Complaint may be submitted using the RTEC ADA Complaint Form or by telephone.
A representative may file for a complainant unable to write a complaint.
A designated RTEC staff member may assist a complainant who cannot write the complaint.
The source gives TTY/Kentucky Relay contact options.
The source includes English and Spanish language-assistance contact language.
investigation_flow: Coordinator contacts complainant and requests any needed information.
Determine whether alleged facts present an ADA-regulation issue.
Determine whether RTEC failed to comply with ADA requirements.
Communicate the response and reasons promptly.
Allow the stated historical appeal period.
Close when no appeal is filed or when the process is otherwise completed.
closure_rule: The historical source says a complaint may be closed if the complainant fails to provide required information within the required timeframe.
currentness_risks: The source's five-calendar-day filing deadline is unusually short and must not be assumed current without validation against a later adopted/public RTEC ADA policy.
Named extensions/TTY numbers and appeal deadlines may be stale.
The source is stored under the Title VI/LEP archive but governs ADA disability complaints; these case types must remain jurisdictionally distinct.
No later standalone RTEC ADA complaint policy has yet been established from the ingested source set.
privacy_controls: Completed ADA complaints, disability facts, medical/supporting evidence and investigation records are restricted case records.
Generalized knowledge may retain blank form/process structure, deadlines, source provenance and non-identifying aggregate metrics.
Do not infer disability status from service complaints unless the complainant actually alleges disability discrimination.
automation_candidates: Restricted ADA complaint case tracker with deadline calculation driven by the validated current policy version.
Accessible intake path that supports assisted/oral complaints without forcing a written-only workflow.
Jurisdiction classifier separating ADA service complaints, Title VI complaints and employment accommodation/EEO cases.
Version-controlled public ADA complaint form and process page with contact/deadline consistency checks.
